feeding_claim.verbatim: We finish them on a grain-fed diet sourced from local farms, enhancing marbling and flavor.

notes: Homepage describes grass-fed, pasture raised, grain finished beef and pasture-raised pork. Beef and pork shares reserved by deposit; FAQ gives freezer space for quarter, half and whole beef. FAQ says the farm may offer home delivery for an extra fee, starting at $100 within 30 miles, and farther by request; it can legally ship but is focusing on local customers, so no shipping recorded. Beef is processed at a USDA-inspected facility in Florence and picked up from the butcher. Many shop items out of stock.
